label: Mark Dead — any family
notes: Applicable to devices at IDMS 7 (Returned RMA), 8 (Returned Non-RMA), or 12 (NF OOW).
Device Type is populated from the Asset's Device_Category__c field at generate time.
Allowed Device Type values: VBUS, DHUB, HAPTIC, WIRELESS_ALERT_BUTTON, Driveri, DMS.
Dead Reason defaults to 'Lost By Customer'; override via the run's sharedFields.dead_reason.
Moves the device from IDMS 7/8/12 to IDMS 9 (Dead).
